entries.text: Queries that use QUALIFY now keep ORDER BY, DISTINCT, LIMIT and OFFSET on the outermost SELECT, after the QUALIFY filter, for every dialect that has no native QUALIFY (Athena, DataFusion, Doris, Dune, Fabric, Greenplum, Hive, Materialize, MySQL, Netezza, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Presto, QuestDB, RisingWave, SingleStore, Spark, SQLite, StarRocks, Trino, T-SQL, Vertica), so the row set and its order match the native QUALIFY result
